featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a **fabulous experience** at the Birkenstock store in Borivali! From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was welcoming and the store was beautifully organized with a great selection of styles and sizes.

What truly made the visit outstanding was the **amazing customer service**. The staff were incredibly friendly, patient, and knowledgeable about the products. They took the time to understand what I was looking for and helped me find the perfect pair, explaining the different footbeds and fits without rushing me at all.

I really appreciated how attentive and professional everyone was. They made the whole shopping experience comfortable and enjoyable, which is something you don’t always find in busy stores.

If you’re looking for quality footwear and **top-notch service**, I highly recommend visiting the Birkenstock store in Borivali. I’ll definitely be coming back again!

featured_reviews.name: Lavy Pinto
featured_reviews.review_text:
*Please train your staff to be honest, open, and forthcoming with the information on offers and such*.

This review is specific to our visit to the Mochi outlet at Sky City Mall on 15.12.25.

We were there to shop for sandals.  We were attended by Mohd Aaman Salauddin Ansari.  Everything went well until the billing.  We asked the sales person if there was any ongoing discount. He said there wasn't, and after looking at the screen for a while, got up and brought us a small bottle of ZeOLite foot spray saying this will be free for you. There was some discrepancy in the billing amount and the MRP of the sandals I had bought. He couldn't clarify it.

Later when we checked the Mochi website we found out that there was 11% discount on the sandals.  Then we looked at the E-bill ( which takes a while to come) and realised what the salesperson had done!
Instead of telling us about the discount, he had made us force buy the product we didn't want or need.

I'd like to feel happy at the end of any shopping experience. Here I felt duped, which is not the kind of shopping experience we usually get in an outlet like Mochi.

Of late they don't deliver,  that is my experience.  I purchased sandals in Jan 2024 and had to go back (within a very short  period of time) due to the defect found in it. I have gone through a lot of hardship & difficulty as both  the new pairs of sandals gave me shoe bites at different places in my both feet.

I am going to write a detailed mail to the customer care with a high expectation.  Let's see what happens after that.

featured_reviews.name: Socorro Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
As per website, this store is supposed to open at 10.30am. waited till 10.45am but the store was still closed. I checked with a couple of neighbouring  stores who infirmed me that they open by 11. Finally at 11am it was opened. When I questioned the cashier (a young male with black shirt and jeans), he chose not to respond. Even his attitude, as though he is least interested to know anything at all about customer service. Absolutely no smile, no responses....
I have been a regular customer of BATA since times immemorial, but never experienced such service

featured_reviews.name: Varsha Suthar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience.
I purchased a pair of shoes,I received a ₹1000 discount on that pair and later exchanged them due to a size issue. However, when my size was not available and I had to exchange for a different shoe, the staff charged me a higher price and did not adjust the earlier discount properly.

If I had to pay full or higher price, I would have directly purchased from Nike. I feel I was misled, important details were not clearly explained, and I ended up facing a loss because of this confusing and unfair process.

What made the experience worse was the non-cooperative and rude behavior of the staff. Instead of helping or explaining calmly, they were arguing and blaming me, which is completely unacceptable.

Overall, a very poor customer service experience. I would not recommend this store unless they improve transparency and staff behavior.

featured_reviews.name: Tushar Adakmol
featured_reviews.review_text:
The staff member who assisted me was extremely helpful and welcomed me with a charming smile. She went out of her way to help me find the exact pair I had been searching for a long time, and that too at a great discounted price.
I am truly grateful for her assistance and would like to appreciate her efforts and excellent customer service 🙌🏽💯🫡. This Outlet was at Oberoi Sky City Borivali
Overall staff was very Great.
